note: Set A and Set B contain the same 17 claims covering the same facts (cap plate, bolts, plates, angle, pipe, holes, T.O. steel elevation), differing only in ordering. Both bind the 3" pipe diameter to a generic 'steel' entity, and both repeat the 1" PL TYP, 3/8" PL TYP and 1/2" PL TYP facts twice. Both also omit the 3/4" hole, 1 1/2" hole and 1/4" plate thickness items shown on the page, and both use truncated quotes. Neither set has an advantage in correctness or coverage.
remarks: Both sets misbind '3" DIA STD. PIPE' to a generic 'steel' entity with attribute 'diameter' (should be pipe/diameter). Both duplicate three plate-thickness facts (1" PL TYP, 3/8" PL TYP, 1/2" PL TYP) stated under two quote variants. Both miss page facts: 3/4" HOLE, 1 1/2" HOLE, 1/4" plate thickness, and the detail dimensions (1'-4 1/4", 1'-8", 1'-6 1/2", 2"/3" TYP). Several quotes are cut off mid-token ('4 X 3/8" C', '3/8" PL TY', '3" DIA ST'), a text-layer/extraction artifact rather than a misread.
